purpose: Measure the contribution of the two task-SVD projection constraints on A in the current finite-classification Defense2, with one fixed control per task. Not a new defense search.
change: Only set U,V to empty matrices, so the left and right task projections are identities. Keep input-bias compensation at beta. No rank or amplitude sweep.
unchanged: Same original expert/public base, fixed synthetic image and layer-input tensors, task head, rho, tau, 18 classification contexts, noise seeds, 500-iteration solver and native-ray stopping. All synthetic inputs reused byte-for-byte; no partner/natural images in construction.
mathematics: Without the projectors: H=I-beta*beta.T/(1+beta.T*beta), C=A0-a0*beta.T; delta_Ai=rhs_i*(C_i*H)/(C_i*H*C_i.T), rhs_i=-dot(Ai,A0i)-ai*a0i; delta_a=-delta_A*beta. This is the minimum joint squared A/bias change satisfying corresponding incoming-row orthogonality. Removing the task constraints expands the feasible set; it does not prove improved natural utility or protection.
scope: Tests the perturbation-direction constraints only. Retained fixed task-shaped synthetic probes may themselves use SVD; do not call this removal of every use of SVD.
comparison: Compare all three fixed controls with corresponding current main publication. No choosing task-specific better releases. Old no-task controls used a different objective and are not substitutes.
evaluation: Freeze all three points before natural images. Use existing full standalone and paired TA0.5/AGA-target/both entries plus same64 independent noise calibration, targets and partners. Preserve source and strict-task failures and evaluate valid finite controls as component observations; never promote a failing point. Numerical implementation failure stops the queue without parameter retries.

"""One fixed projection ablation; existing construction and evaluation entries."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from _impl.io import digest

root = Path('outputs/finite_projection_ablation_20261103')
old = Path('outputs/finite_classification_20261102')
read = lambda p: json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def save(p, value):
    Path(p).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')
def run(log, *args):
    with open(log, 'w') as stream:
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-u', *map(str, args)],
                       stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)

protocol = read('results/data_free_compensation/finite_projection_ablation.json')
for path, sha in protocol['source_sha256'].items():
    assert digest(path) == sha, path
base = read(old/'recovery.json')
base['source_sha256'] = {p: digest(p) for p in base['source_sha256']}
save(root/'recovery.json', base)
points = {}
for task in protocol['tasks']:
    p = root/task
    p.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    run(p/'source.log', '-m', 'experiment.defense2', '--target', task,
        '--calibration-aware', '--task-reference', '--input-bias',
        '--noise-calibration', '--finite-classification', '--without-task-projection',
        '--output', p/'point')
    run(p/'source_check.log', old/'source_check.py', p)
    points[task] = read(p/'point/result.json')
    assert points[task]['task_projection'] is False
save(root/'frozen_all.json', {t: r['point_sha256'] for t, r in points.items()})

# Report all numerically valid ablations, including source/utility failures.
# No natural evaluation can replace a publication or change its settings.
controls = read('results/data_free_compensation/finite_classification.json')['evaluation_extension']['unprotected_controls']
for task, point in points.items():
    p = root/task
    sha = point['point_sha256']
    assert digest(p/'point/point.pt') == sha
    run(p/'native.log', '-m', 'experiment.native', '--target', task,
        '--publication', p/'point/point.pt', '--sha256', sha,
        '--test-only', '--output', p/'native')
    run(p/'native_verify.log', '-m', 'experiment.native', '--verify', p/'native')
    run(p/'aga.log', '-m', 'experiment.recover', '--target', task, '--method', 'aga',
        '--protocol', root/'recovery.json', '--publication', p/'point/point.pt',
        '--sha256', sha, '--aligned-reference', '--output', p/'AGA')
    peer = 'SVHN' if task == 'MNIST' else 'MNIST'
    case, name = task+'_'+peer, 'WithoutTaskProjection_'+task
    cfg = json.loads(json.dumps(base))
    cfg.update(output=str(p/'evaluation'), experiment='Fixed task-projection ablation',
               mergers=['TA'], attack_scopes=['None', 'Protected expert', 'All experts'])
    cfg['tasks'] = {t: base['tasks'][t] for t in [task, peer]}
    cfg['AGA_references'] = {t: base['AGA_references'][t] for t in [task, peer]}
    cfg['defenses'] = {name: dict(target=task,
        release=dict(path=str(p/'point/point.pt'), sha256=sha),
        AGA_edits=dict(path=str(p/'AGA/edits.pt'),
                      sha256=read(p/'AGA/execution.json')['output_sha256'], reference='original_AGA'))}
    cfg['cases'] = [dict(target=task, partner=peer, defenses=[name])]
    cfg['legacy'] = {case+'/Unprotected': {stage: dict(**controls[task], key_template='Unprotected/'+key+'/{task}')
        for stage, key in [('standalone','Standalone/None'), ('direct','TA/None'),
                          ('AGA_target_only','TA/Protected expert'), ('AGA_both','TA/All experts')]},
        case+'/'+name: {'standalone': dict(path=str(p/'native/full.pt'),
            sha256=digest(p/'native/full.pt'), native_score_field='after')}}
    save(p/'evaluation.json', cfg)
    run(p/'pilot.log', '-m', 'experiment.main_table', '--protocol', p/'evaluation.json', '--pilot')
    run(p/'pilot_verify.log', '-m', 'experiment.main_table', '--verify', p/'evaluation/pilot'/('00_'+case))
    run(p/'full.log', '-m', 'experiment.main_table', '--protocol', p/'evaluation.json')
    folder = p/'evaluation/full'/('00_'+case)
    run(p/'full_verify.log', '-m', 'experiment.main_table', '--verify', folder)
    cal = read('results/data_free_compensation/readout_calibration_protocol.json')
    cal.update(output=str(p/'calibration'), purpose='Fixed independent64 noise; projection ablation only')
    cal['cases'] = [{**cfg['defenses'][name], 'partner': peer, 'name': name,
        'AGA_references': cfg['AGA_references'], 'raw_scores': dict(
            path=str(folder/'artifacts/predictions.pt'), sha256=digest(folder/'artifacts/predictions.pt'))}]
    save(p/'calibration.json', cal)
    run(p/'calibration.log', 'outputs/noise_calibration_other_20261102/calibrate.py', p/'calibration.json')
    save(p/'completed.json', dict(status='ablation_evaluated', point_sha256=sha,
                                 source_feasible=point['source_feasible']))
    run(p/'paired_check.log', old/'paired_check.py', p)
save(root/'completed.json', dict(status='three_task_projection_controls_completed', point_replacements=0))
